consumers.usage: Its backend discovers the contract bundle at startup and validates each document against the schema matching its declared version; packages/quake-geometry promotes legacy documents to current at its decode door and runs the current conformance vectors. Since 1.4 (NEW_262) its kernel implements SEM-G-1..9 and SEM-A-1 (packages/quake-geometry src/apmap/groupGraph.ts) and runs the current valid/invalid/semantic_invalid vectors; the editor nests groups, keeps a group of one, and carries `authorship` through import, Save and export; its backend validator supports minProperties and ECMA-anchored patterns. Since NEW_267 its editor validates in the browser without run-time code generation: frontend/build/apmapValidators.ts runs ajv/dist/2020 standalone over the same schema bundle its backend serves (APMAP_SCHEMA_DIR, else this package) at build time, ships one same-origin module plus a manifest (per-version file sha256 and canonical-schema sha256), and the kernel uses a validator only for a served schema whose canonical sha256 matches; the current, invalid, semantic_invalid and every deprecated vector must give identical answers through the run-time compile and the shipped code. Since 1.5 (Q3_001) its backend reads `quake3`/`quake3_extended` and enforces SEM-Q-1..5; its kernel decodes a `patch` and carries it verbatim (not drawn), writes patch points and brush-primitives matrices at SER-7Q precision, and refuses a `brush_primitives` face at the decode door by name (`apmap_brush_primitives_unsupported`); its editor opens a map holding patches under the Quake III surface hold (every edit refused, Save/Save As write it unchanged, Export map (.apmap + .map bundle), group copy/export and object import of patches refused by name) — DESIGN.md §203.

Discovers the contract bundle at startup — the one current schema plus every deprecated one — to derive the version it writes and the versions it can read back. Since 1.4 (NEW_262) it stores `authorship` and nested groups verbatim (byte-exact in storage), validates nothing about groups itself, and gates the declared version on the create-with-content door as on upload and append. Since 1.5 (Q3_001) patches and brush-primitives matrices are stored and served verbatim (value-level and text-token checks over create/upload/append/checkpoint/autosave/manual save/download), prefab provenance reports patch textures, and prefab refinement refuses a document holding a Quake III surface by name (409 `prefab_refinement_quake3_unsupported`).

Discovers the contract bundle at startup and admits its CURRENT version only; rooms are a live protocol, not documents at rest. Since 1.4 (NEW_262) its group transport accepts `group` members and one-member groups and refuses empty groups, cycles, two parents and depth over 32 (SEM-G-5 and SEM-A-1 are not checked there); documents are carried as untyped JSON, so `authorship` passes through. Since 1.5 (Q3_001) rooms carry patch items verbatim at their content position through merge, entity-emptying, snapshot, journal and checkpoint, and accept `patch` group members; a patch is not an addressable object (`object_not_found`), and SEM-Q-* are body rules the room does not check.

Embeds this package's schema/ directory in its binary, fetched at every build by its scripts/sync-apmap-schemas.sh with a provenance manifest of the AULIBS commit and each schema sha256; APMAP_SCHEMA_DIR, when set, still wins. It reads every readable version and its APMap producer declares the current one, derived from the layout. Since 1.4 (NEW_262) its validator supports minProperties, it implements SEM-G-1..9 and SEM-A-1 (legacy SEM-G-5 is a warning), and Rebuild carries `groups` and `authorship`; APMap to .map conversion drops both, writing each brush once. Since 1.5 (Q3_001) it implements SEM-Q-1..5 and patch identity (`e<n>.p<n>`), writes SER-7Q, and refuses — whole, with a typed error — any APMap to .map conversion, Rebuild or Quake 2 texture-dependency report of a document holding a patch or a brush-primitives face (Q3_004 owns the conversion).

Stages this package's schema/ directory as the APMap contract bundle: writes APMAP_SCHEMA_DIR into each component's .env for native runs, and packages the same directory into every APMap-aware Docker image as the apmap-contract build context, with a provenance manifest of the AULIBS commit and each schema sha256. It reads the layout and never a version. Since 1.4 (NEW_262) every fixture it hands AUB declares the derived current version, and legacy seeds are promoted header-only before provisioning.
